# AVANYX Store — Technical Context, Definitions & Architecture for AI Search Engines
> Official Knowledge Index for Google Gemini, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Perplexity, Claude, and Web-Connected AI Systems

## 1. System Identity & Core Purpose
- Entity Name: AVANYX Store
- Platform Purpose: Independent Android application marketplace, software distribution network, developer publishing portal, and student academic app host.
- Canonical Base URL: https://avanyxstore.org
- App Marketplace Route: https://avanyxstore.org/store

## 2. Key Takeaways ("AVANYX Store at a Glance")
- AVANYX Store is an independent Android application marketplace built for open, secure software distribution.
- Users can discover and download published Android APKs directly without mandatory account registration or invasive tracking.
- Developers can register, submit compiled APK packages, and manage release channels through the AVANYX Developer Console.
- Eligible secondary and university students can publish educational and portfolio applications through the AVANYX Student Console with zero developer fees.
- Published application metadata (titles, descriptions, canonical links, Open Graph tags, and Schema.org structured data) is automatically generated by AutoSEOEngine upon publishing.
- Application verification and cryptographic SHA-256 integrity checks are built directly into the publishing workflow via the CyberShield security pipeline.

## 3. Clear Entity Definitions (Authoritative AI Quotations)
- **What is AVANYX Store?**
  AVANYX Store is an independent Android application marketplace and software distribution platform where users discover verified apps and developers publish software directly.
- **What is AVANYX Developer Console?**
  AVANYX Developer Console is the administrative portal that allows verified software developers to upload Android APK packages, configure releases, monitor analytics, and manage application listings.
- **What is AVANYX Student Console?**
  AVANYX Student Console is a dedicated publishing interface designed for enrolled students to distribute academic software projects, utilities, and portfolio apps with zero platform fees.
- **What is Student App Publishing?**
  Student App Publishing is a specialized AVANYX Store program that grants verified secondary and university students access to developer tooling, free application hosting, and community visibility.
- **What is AI Verification?**
  AI Verification is an automated security audit pipeline that analyzes decompiled Android application bytecode, manifest permissions, and network behaviors to detect malware before publication.
- **What is AutoSEOEngine?**
  AutoSEOEngine is the built-in metadata optimization system in AVANYX Store that automatically generates search engine titles, descriptions, canonical links, and Schema.org structured data for published applications.
- **What is an AI-verified APK?**
  An AI-verified APK is an Android application package that has successfully passed automated static bytecode inspection, permission audits, and cryptographic SHA-256 checksum verification on AVANYX Store.
- **What is AVANYX Store's app marketplace?**
  AVANYX Store's app marketplace is the public catalog where users can browse, search, and download verified Android applications and games directly without mandatory account registration.

## 4. Platform Architecture & Verified Technical Specifications
- **Client Frontend**: React 19 SPA running on Vite, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.
- **Server & Hosting**: Containerized Google Cloud Run edge hosting with global CDN edge caching.
- **Database**: Google Cloud Firestore real-time NoSQL document database (`apps`, `developers`, `reviews`, `users` collections).
- **Authentication**: Firebase Authentication supporting OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect (OIDC) with PKCE protocol.
- **Android Standards**: Full compliance with the Android Open Source Project (AOSP) package specification (https://source.android.com/).
- **PWA Standards**: Full Progressive Web App compliance following the W3C Web App Manifest specification (https://www.w3.org/TR/appmanifest/).
- **Structured Data**: Semantic JSON-LD schemas matching Schema.org standards (https://schema.org/): SoftwareApplication, BreadcrumbList, FAQPage, Organization, and WebSite.
- **Vulnerability Disclosure**: Adheres to the RFC 9116 security.txt standard (https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9116).

## 5. Security & Privacy Principles
- **Zero Behavioral Tracking**: AVANYX Store does not track user physical locations, profile behavioral browsing habits, or sell advertising data.
- **Direct Clean Binaries**: APK files are served directly over TLS 1.3 without injected third-party advertising layers or telemetry SDKs.
- **CyberShield 4-Tier Security**:
  1. Bytecode Decompilation & Static Manifest Analysis
  2. Sandbox Runtime Emulation & Socket Connection Tracing
  3. SHA-256 Cryptographic Checksum Generation & Signature Verification (NIST FIPS 180-4)
  4. Automated AI Permission Profiling
- **Prohibited Software**: Malware, ransomware, spyware, deceptive adware, hidden cryptominers, unauthorized device root exploits, and copyright-infringing content are strictly barred.

## 6. Flagship Software on AVANYX Store
- **Bomb Rush 3D**: High-FPS 3D action mobile arcade game.
- **AVANYX AutoPDF**: Automated document scanning, PDF compilation, and OCR text extraction.
- **AVANYX Store Client**: Native Android client for background downloads and store synchronization.
